name: The Server
source:
An otome mystery visual novel set in a fog-shrouded coastal town. Work as a waitress at an exclusive supper club, romance four men hiding dangerous secrets, and uncover the truth buried beneath. Every choice you make shapes your path and where it ends.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4674920/The_Server/]Steam[/url]]
